blocks._note: The sheet says WHICH state each sport is in; this says what that state SOUNDS like. Two sports across four states is sixteen combinations, so the sentence is composed from fragments rather than written out. The form sits below it in every state — Google Forms is the authority on whether it will take an answer, and says so more precisely than this file could: a form scheduled to open announces the date and time itself. The closing line is the same in every state and says nothing about the form, so it cannot contradict the sentence above it. The full mapping is documented in docs/content-sync-spec.md §5.6.
